beats.desc: the man holds the new stainless exterior deadbolt cylinder with its tailpiece and aligns it to the upper round bore hole on the front face of the white door, his other hand steadying the door edge
he pushes the deadbolt cylinder into the upper bore hole so its tailpiece passes through toward the latch, seating the cylinder flush against the door face
beats.constraint: both hands stay at the upper bore hole and the cylinder stays aligned to the hole.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt inserts a new exterior deadbolt cylinder into the door bore, working with both hands; the man
